raw.query: SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='v_pool_latency'
raw.observed: v_pool_latency exposes lead_s + p50/p90/p99/max_ms encoder/llm latency only; no onset_magnitude, no survival/feasibility, no pod-scheduled GPU worker cold_start/scheduling latency column
raw.claimed: medium onsets survive only sub-minute leads (L*=45 s, below what pod-scheduled GPU workers realistically offer)
raw.evidence: Owning view v_pool_latency holds per-lead latency percentiles but no onset-class, survival, or pod-GPU-scheduling dimension, so the causal sub-minute-survival/pod-scheduling assertion has no backing there.
raw.fix: Back the onset-survival claim with the burst/lead-feasibility view that classifies onset magnitude and records survival vs lead, and separately source pod-scheduled GPU worker cold-start latency (v_dim/v_pool_cost cold_start_s or a scheduling-trace view); do not derive it from v_pool_latency.
